title: Bodycam: Man Allegedly Attacks Bride and Incites Chaotic Fight at Wedding
description:
A wedding reception erupted in chaos after a Florida man allegedly pushed the bride to the ground and attacked other attendees on February 24, 2024. The Pinellas County Sheriff's Office said Rontae Stokes incited the fight after getting into a verbal argument and pushing the bride-to-be to the ground. Get all the details on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam. 

Get 50% off of confidential background reports at https://www.truthfinder.com/bodycamchannel

Strokes then allegedly threw furniture through a glass door, causing over $800 in damages. He is also accused of striking multiple wedding guests while being escorted off the property. The foul-mouthed suspect was not compliant with deputies and claimed the whole situation was “bulls**t.” He was charged with five counts of felony battery and one count of criminal mischief. The case is still pending. Stokes has not entered a plea yet.
